name: camera
description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Rounded rectangular outer shell has bounds x=2.15..21.85 and y=3.25..20.75. Horizontal shoulder ledges at y=5.95 (x=5..7.5 and x=16.5..19) match the narrowed raised housing in Outline. A circular lens counter and small indicator counter preserve recognition without overlapping strokes. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.
